overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET VALUE command assigns a specified value to a designated cell range.

constraints: If rangeObj includes multiple cells, the same valueObj is repeated in every cell.
valueObj.value accepts Integer, Real, Boolean, Text, Date, or Null (any type except time); pass Null to erase the cell content.
valueObj.time (Real, in seconds) is used instead of value to set a time value.
valueObj.format is a pattern applied to value/time; see Cell Format.
